Desarrollo de capas de AlN sobre aleaciones de aluminio como protección superficial contra la corrosión y el desgaste (https://arxiv.org/abs/1408.1378)
citeturn91academia9 [wordlim: 200] Published: 12.2 years ago; 
Title: Desarrollo de capas de AlN sobre aleaciones de aluminio como protección superficial contra la corrosión y el desgaste
Authors: Juan Bürgi, Javier García Molleja, Liliana Nosei, Francine Roudet, Julio Ferrón, Jorge Feugeas
Date: Wed Aug  6 19:07:37 2014

Aluminum and their alloys, after careful treatments, can develop excellent mechanical, tribological, electrical and chemical (high corrosion resistance) properties. However, 7000 series, with Cu in the alloy, have a poor corrosion resistance. On the other hand, aluminum nitride (AlN) has a wurtzitic phase and good thermal stability, optical, electric, piezoelectric, mechanical, tribological, and chemical properties, so the application range is huge. In this paper, AlN deposition on Al 7075 was done using the reactive magnetron sputtering technique in order to verify the aluminum nitride performance as an Al alloy protective film under wear and corrosive processes.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Tirocinio Formativo Attivo: il Laboratorio Pedagogico Didattico TIC della Classe A049 nell'Ateneo di Palermo (https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.00078)
citeturn91academia10 [wordlim: 200] Published: 11.2 years ago; 
Title: Tirocinio Formativo Attivo: il Laboratorio Pedagogico Didattico TIC della Classe A049 nell'Ateneo di Palermo
Authors: Lucia Lupo, Aurelio Agliolo Gallitto
Date: Sat Aug  1 05:05:38 2015

We discuss the organization of the course of Laboratorio Pedagogico Didattico TIC of the Tirocinio Formativo Attivo at the University of Palermo. The course takes into account the development of information and communication technologies both for the management/administration of school and their application in Mathematics and Physics education. In particular, we will discuss in detail the various possibilities of renewing the teaching given by communication and sharing tools of web 2.0, the use of the digital whiteboard, and the use of technologies in Mathematics and Physics laboratories, up to the use of multimedia mobile devices as experimental tools.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Las actividades de laboratorio en Física: un cambio en la estructura a favor del conocimiento científico (https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10151)
citeturn91academia11 [wordlim: 200] Published: 2.4 years ago; 
Title: Las actividades de laboratorio en Física: un cambio en la estructura a favor del conocimiento científico
Authors: Andrea Pereira, Álvaro Suárez
Date: Fri Jun 14 16:05:22 2024

In this article we argue how the use of structured laboratory guides are pedagogically inadequate for meaningful learning. Subsequently, an approach to laboratory activities in accordance with scientific work and the constructivist vision of learning is described, exemplifying how this approach can be applied to restructure a usual laboratory practice.
